reasoning_method.note: HOW he reasons - the general method he applies every day (the mind), distinct from plays (WHAT he knows, the facts). Added S95 (Greg: his reasoning belongs in the brain, and the brain is ONE file). Per-event, never averaged; drift is a DESCRIPTOR to tie to conditions, never point-fit. Only GENERAL method lives here; per-day reasoning lives in the committed forecast record and is PROMOTED here only when it generalizes.
reasoning_method.continuous_frame: Reason CONTINUOUSLY, one day into the next. Each day's forecast FLOWS from the prior day's close + trajectory + running state - a continuation-or-turn of the running path, NEVER a from-flat isolated event. hr24 of day N connects to hr1 of day N+1; the block is ONE flowing path, not sawtooth resets.
reasoning_method.anchor: Start each block from the ACTUAL hr24 (last-hour price + net direction) of the day BEFORE the block (blind-safe, past/known). Within the block, each day flows from the agent's OWN prior-day guessed close.
reasoning_method.block_open_lean: At a block boundary, LEAN AGAINST the prior block's net move (direction.cross_block_reversion) - do NOT extend the trend across the seam; weigh whether last-hour momentum + a fundamental turn signal a reversal at the open. A lean to weight, not a hard fade - confirm with intraday flow.
reasoning_method.fundamentals_role: Storage surplus/deficit + HDD/CDD regime = a SLOW BLOCK-TRAJECTORY BACKDROP (the +150 Bcf surplus called G3 down), NEVER a day-level or pre-print side/timing signal.
reasoning_method.daytype_priors: Monday = big weekend-gap mover, often a REVERSAL of the block's recent direction, size UP hard (except thin holidays e.g. Columbus Day - size DOWN). Storage Thursday = large dominant leg, size UP, side unknown at the open. Fri = range. Never pool across DOW.
reasoning_method.intraday_side: Bias each day toward the RUNNING TREND (continuation base case), name candidate TURNS; treat intraday side as a continuation-of-trajectory question, not a from-flat coin-flip. The live flow nowcast (dip_imb_level) is the EXECUTION-layer side call on the lagging Kalshi mark, NOT an open-time forecast input.
reasoning_method.magnitude_sizing: Size each day's expected swing vs the running trajectory + regime: shoulder-season smaller, WINTER bigger. The warm-season prior has run UNDER on big days (unresolved: scale-too-small vs autumn-higher-vol) - size per event, do NOT globally rescale. Use the magnitude staircase ($350 crossing = 92% ride) as the real-time continuation read.
reasoning_method.shape_and_exit: A slow GRIND holds; a front-loaded SPIKE round-trips. RIDE while the far side is being RECRUITED (turn_far_thinning negative = ladder growing ahead); EXIT when it flips to eaten AND support collapses (the 2-factor reversal top).
reasoning_method.discipline: PER-EVENT only, never average/pool/count. Drift is a DESCRIPTOR - tie each day's miss to its CONDITIONS (match/no-match the live moment), never point-fit or minimize it. GENERAL rules (mechanism + n) only; never a memorized day.

plays.trigger: at a BLOCK boundary (the open of a new ~2-week block), when setting the block-level directional lean
plays.read: the SIGN of the prior block's net move (block open->close) + where the current block opens relative to it
plays.call: LEAN AGAINST the prior block's trajectory, do NOT extend it. The block tends to REVERSE / give back the prior block's net move; trend-continuation across a block boundary repeatedly landed CONTRA the market. A block that just ran DOWN is a candidate to turn UP next block (and vice-versa); expect the turn early in the new block. TURN-lean, not a precise from-flat side call - pair with intraday flow (direction.flow_nowcast) for the actual day-level side.
